items.headline: US Equities Retreat as Oil Prices Surge Amid Middle East Tensions
items.summary: U.S. equity markets edged lower today, extending losses as rising crude oil prices and escalating geopolitical tensions in the Middle East pressured investor sentiment. The S&P 500, Dow Jones Industrial Average, and Nasdaq Composite all registered declines, with higher Treasury yields particularly impacting large growth stocks.

items.headline: Micron Surges on Trade Policy Signals
items.summary: Micron Technology (MU) gained 4.1% following signals of U.S. trade policy resisting Apple's sourcing of memory components from China.

items.headline: Caterpillar Leads Dow Gainers
items.summary: Caterpillar (CAT) led Dow gainers, rising 3.13% in today's session.

items.headline: Microsoft Slides Amid Higher Yields
items.summary: Microsoft (MSFT) dropped 3.0% as higher long-term Treasury yields weighed on large growth stocks.

items.headline: Meta Platforms Down on Yield Concerns
items.summary: Meta Platforms (META) slipped 3.5% as rising Treasury yields pressured the tech sector.

items.headline: Constellation Brands Falls After Berkshire Exit
items.summary: Constellation Brands (STZ) fell 6.2% after Berkshire Hathaway disclosed it had exited its position in the company.

items.headline: Oil Prices Surge on Middle East Geopolitical Tensions
items.summary: Brent crude prices rose above $91 a barrel as intensifying US-Iran tensions in the Middle East and renewed fighting in Lebanon fueled concerns over energy supplies and global inflation. This surge in oil prices is a key factor impacting overall market sentiment today.

items.headline: Home Depot Reports Q2 Earnings Ahead of Bell
items.summary: Home Depot ($HD) reported its second-quarter earnings before the market opened. Analysts were anticipating earnings per share around $4.71-$4.73 on revenue close to $47 billion, providing a key read on consumer spending in the home improvement sector.

items.headline: Key US Economic Data Releases Today
items.summary: Investors are monitoring several key U.S. economic data releases today, including July Housing Starts, Building Permits, and Industrial Production figures, which could provide further insights into the health of the economy.

items.headline: Treasury Yields Climb, Impacting Growth Stocks
items.summary: The yield on the 10-year Treasury climbed to 4.72% from 4.68% late Friday, driven by rising oil prices and inflation concerns. Higher yields exerted pressure on large growth stocks, contributing to the broader market downturn.

items.headline: Technology and Energy Sectors Show Divergent Trends
items.summary: Globally, the Information Technology sector is showing strong relative momentum, while the Energy sector has moved into a lagging position. In India, Nifty IT and Realty sectors declined, while Nifty Auto and Pharma outperformed.
